media_settings_section_description: Click a media item to set its alt text, or its thumbnail if it is a video.
media_settings_section_tooltip: Thumbnails apply to videos in the main post and are sent to every channel that supports them. YouTube may ignore them on videos it treats as Shorts (vertical, up to 3 minutes) without failing the publish, and requires a phone-verified channel for custom thumbnails. If YouTube rejects the thumbnail the video is still published, and Postiz cannot check eligibility in advance.
youtube_thumbnail_overrides_media: This post has a YouTube-specific thumbnail, which overrides the thumbnail set in the media settings.
advertising_thumbnail_unavailable: The preview is not available yet or is still being prepared. Check the original file before you submit.
advertising_creative_preview: Preview only. The ad platform may show your ad differently.
advertising_workspace_asset_notice: Workspace file: {{mediaId}}. It still needs to be uploaded to the ad platform and processed.
advertising_review_draft_budget: Daily budget: {{currency}} {{amount}}. This only applies when you create a new budget or change the budget. Runs {{start}} to {{end}} (account time zone: {{timezone}})
advertising_immediate_on_submission: Starts as soon as it is submitted
advertising_ongoing_provider_limit: Runs until paused or the platform end date
advertising_review_requested_action: Requested action: {{operation}}. New campaign items are created paused. Resuming turns on delivery and spending.
advertising_review_observed_campaign: Current campaign on the ad platform: {{name}} · {{status}} · budget {{budget}} (platform units)
advertising_approval_does_not_submit: Approving does not send anything to the ad platform. Submitting is a separate step that you confirm, and it only works once an administrator has turned on ad submissions. Approval expires: {{expiresAt}}
advertising_request_plan_context: What will be sent to the ad platform
advertising_validate_without_submitting: Check with the ad platform (nothing is submitted)
advertising_execution_id_notice: Submission ID: {{id}}. The IDs below come from the ad platform. They do not mean the ads are approved or will deliver.
advertising_reconcile_outcome: Check the result with the ad platform
advertising_rejected_child_notice: To change a rejected item, stop the remaining steps first. Everything already created stays as it is. Then create a new draft that uses the existing IDs. Stopping does not delete or turn on anything on the ad platform.
advertising_abandon_remaining: Stop remaining steps and keep what was created
advertising_final_submission_notice: You are about to submit to {{account}}: {{currency}} {{amount}} per day, {{start}} to {{end}}. Resuming can start spending money.
advertising_authorize_operation: I approve this change for the account, budget, currency and schedule shown above.
advertising_operator_must_enable: Submitting is turned off. Ask an administrator to turn on advertising changes.
advertising_execution_result: Submission result: {{status}}. Check the IDs of the created items and the change history.
advertising_saved_locally: Draft saved. Nothing was sent to the ad platform.
advertising_request_failed: The request did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
advertising_provider_unavailable: The ad platform could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
advertising_intro: Create campaign drafts, get them reviewed and submit them. Saving a draft or approving it does not publish anything. Nothing is sent to the ad platform until you submit it and confirm.
advertising_live_writes_enabled: You can submit approved changes to the ad platform.
advertising_live_writes_disabled: Submitting to the ad platform is turned off. Ask an administrator to turn it on.
advertising_workspace_load_failed: Could not load your campaigns. Refresh the page or try again in a moment.
advertising_account_disconnected: Not connected or not selected. You can save drafts, but you cannot submit them.
advertising_resource_error: {{error}}. Reconnect the account or try again later. Nothing was changed.
advertising_row_details: Budgets, targeting, creatives and policy details
advertising_no_resources: Nothing found on the ad platform.
advertising_pause_resume_hint: To pause or resume a campaign, open the Campaign Builder and enter the campaign ID from this list. Account ownership is checked again during review.
advertising_type_campaign: Campaign (creates a new campaign with its ad sets and ads)
advertising_type_ad_group: Ad set / ad group in an existing campaign
advertising_type_ad: Ad in an existing ad set / ad group
advertising_existing_campaign_id: Campaign ID on the ad platform
advertising_parent_ad_group_id: Parent ad set / ad group ID
advertising_fields_to_change: What do you want to change? Everything else stays the same.
advertising_targeting_replaces: This replaces the current audience: countries and languages for Google (excluded locations are kept), or audience and placements for Meta.
advertising_shared_budget_ack: This budget is shared. I understand that changing it changes the budget for every campaign listed in the final review.
advertising_pixel_workflow: This setup optimizes for website {{goal}} using a Meta Pixel that belongs to this ad account. Lead forms, shop/catalog and messaging ads are not covered here.
advertising_app_authorized: The connected ad account must have permission to advertise this app and track installs.
advertising_start_immediately: Start as soon as submitted (items are still created paused)
advertising_ongoing_budget: Keep running with this daily budget until paused or the platform end date
advertising_inherits_parent: This item uses the budget, dates and targeting of its parent. They are shown in the final review, and this change does not alter them.
advertising_timezone_notice: Account time zone: {{timezone}}. A daily budget is not a limit on total spend, and the platform may spend more on some days. Automatic bidding needs conversion tracking to be set up correctly. Ad sets and ads follow the campaign bid strategy. A manual CPC for an ad group only works in manual CPC campaigns.
advertising_google_schedule_notice: Google campaigns run on calendar dates in the account time zone, and the end date is included. Start and stop times within a day are not supported. The exact dates are shown in the final confirmation.
advertising_google_languages_notice: Google Search chooses languages from your ad text and user signals. Choosing languages manually is no longer supported.
advertising_remove_legacy_language: Remove the old language setting before review
advertising_save_notice: Saving creates a draft only. Nothing is sent to the ad platform until you approve and submit it.
advertising_admins_only: Workspace administrators can create and edit drafts.
advertising_approval_queue_notice: Only workspace owners can approve and submit. Approving and submitting are two separate steps.
advertising_history_notice: Shows the latest 200 changes in this workspace. Each review keeps the exact changes that were proposed.
advertising_asset_request_failed: The request did not go through. Try again.
advertising_asset_request_failed_short: Could not complete the request. Try again.
advertising_select_account_for_assets: Choose an advertising account to manage its creative files.

advertising_discover_assets: Find Pages and files on the ad account

advertising_use_refresh_reconcile: Refresh the file status before you upload again.
advertising_execution_not_enabled: Uploads are turned off. Ask an administrator to turn on advertising changes.

advertising_refresh_reconcile: Refresh the file status before you upload again.
advertising_none_select_hash: None, or choose an existing image from the ad account
advertising_provider_id_unconfirmed: Not yet confirmed by the ad platform
advertising_provider_pages_assets: Pages and files on the ad account

reports_campaign_saved: Campaign saved. Build the report to compare its observed post performance.

paid_spend_trend_caption: Spend trend in the account currency. Days without data are left blank.
paid_values_verified: Purchase values are correct (needed to show ROAS)
paid_request_failed: The report request did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
paid_collection_queued: {{queued}} data collection jobs started. Only days that have ended in the account time zone are collected. Reload when they finish.
paid_schedule_saved: Schedule saved. The first report is created in about a minute if scheduled reports are turned on.
paid_intro: Paid results from Meta Ads and Google Ads. Organic results are shown separately. Totals are shown separately for each account, currency, time zone and attribution setting.
paid_sync: Update data for the selected dates and comparison period
paid_collection_disabled: Data collection is turned off. You can still view saved reports. Ask an administrator to turn it on.
paid_no_snapshots: No paid data for this selection yet. Connect an advertising account, select it, assign it to a client, then update the data for these dates.

paid_definitions: How metrics are defined and attribution limits
paid_jobs_errors: Data collection runs and connection errors
paid_scheduler_notice: Reports are saved to a private archive or sent as a secure download link to a workspace member. Reports never have a public link.
paid_require_fresh: Only run when recent and comparison data are complete
advertising_hint_meta_pixel_id: Must belong to the selected advertising account.
advertising_hint_app_store_url: Use the official Apple or Google store link. It must match the destination URL.
advertising_hint_meta_page_id: Meta checks this when you review the draft.
